actual_scope: Prove a sharp 128 COPY-rank floor for two-call P112 cross forms beta01=r_i v^T and rowspace(beta10) contained in the exceptional source-normal span, including an undecided rank-(1,2) fixture.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for formalization. This contribution instead proves a new scoped binary transfer implication left open by PR2395, with a written proof and exact finite evidence. No kernel formalization is claimed.
bottleneck_link: The new double-term price rules out an exceptional-hull route to sub-128 two-call COPY, directing residual searches toward cross forms outside this family.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved higher-rank case and package it; do not extend to arbitrary residual rank pairs.
evidence: Written Schur-feedback proof; 8192 transfer instances; 6561 support-span double matrices for a rank-(1,2), minimum-(0,0) fixture; sharp 128 coordinate attainer; two price-15 hypothesis-removal controls.
